September 19, 2025 - The London Metal Exchange (LME) is a futures and forwards exchange in London, United Kingdom with the world's largest market in standardised forward contracts, futures contracts and options on base metals. The exchange also offers contracts on ferrous metals and precious metals.

Participants from non-ferrous, ferrous, electric vehicle and financial communities use the LME to mitigate or take on risk using globally trusted prices discovered on our markets. LME futures contracts are underpinned by a world-wide network of warehouses ensuring the prices discovered on our markets are reflective of global supply and demand.
